summary: P2b Stripe payment E2E verified end-to-end through real Stripe hosted checkout. Backend endpoints and full UI flow (login → storefront → checkout dialog → place & pay → Stripe → success page → order status paid) all pass. Cancel route also renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2640 lines; consider splitting into routers (payments, orders, catalog, auth) for maintainability.

POST /api/payments/checkout hard-codes currency 'cad' but Stripe Checkout offers a currency chooser (CAD/USD) automatically because of Stripe account presentment settings. Currency is consistent, but consider storing the presented currency after payment for reporting.
Stripe webhook signature verification is present (good). STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET default '' will silently 400 on any webhook if not configured — fine for now, just document requirement.
PaymentReturn.js polls only 6 times × 2s = 12s max; if Stripe is slow the UI may show 'still processing' — consider extending or listening via webhook confirmation only.
